theorems.name: Submission.ind_rescaled_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (x : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), ∀ y, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) y = (r ^ (m + 1))⁻¹ • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (r⁻¹ • (y - x))) ∧ (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), (∀ y, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) y = (r ^ (m + 1))⁻¹ • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (r⁻¹ • (y - x))) → Y ω = X η) ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y) ∧ (X.boundary = 0 → Y.boundary = 0) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), Y.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ (m + 1))⁻¹) * X.massOn {y | r⁻¹ • (y - x) ∈ W}
